topics.title: Alibaba just dropped Wan3.0, its next-gen AI video generator
topics.why: AI-made video just got another quality jump -- if you're using AI tools for content or marketing, the bar for what looks 'good enough' to ship keeps moving fast.

topics.title: Anthropic's IPO could value it north of $2 trillion, maybe as soon as October
topics.why: A public listing that size means way more scrutiny on the company behind Claude -- and signals investors still think the AI boom has room to run.

topics.title: AI-linked layoffs have already hit 205,000 workers in 2026 -- matching all of last year
topics.why: Customer service, data ops, entry-level software, and finance back-office roles are getting hit hardest -- worth knowing if your job touches any of those.
